summary: Frontend-only UI redesign regression test. Public pages (/, /how-it-works) render in the new editorial style with all required data-testids present and 0 console errors. Authenticated pages (/dashboard, /jobs, /applications, /interview-prep, /profile) all load correctly with the seeded cookie session_token=ui-preview-token-777 — NO redirects to landing, dark left sidebar (data-testid=navbar) visible, target page testids present, and core data loads (Dashboard shows 'Welcome back, Alex' with stats; profile shows Alex Rivera / alex@example.com). Sidebar navigation works between all 5 pages plus back-to-home. user-menu-trigger opens dropdown; logout-btn present. Mobile viewport (390px) shows navbar-mobile with a working mobile-menu-toggle that reveals nav items (verified visually via screenshot). No uncaught JS errors on any authenticated route.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 'Aggregator search error: Failed to fetch' and 'Job search error: TypeError: network error' when /jobs page loads. This is the Ashby scraper placeholder aggregator (expected mocked per review_request.mocked_apis). Does not block rendering — page renders fine. Flag only because errors are logged to console.

action_items: Nothing critical. Optional: silence/handle the aggregator fetch error on /jobs so console stays clean (the scraper is a known placeholder).
Minor: review_request mentioned Applications sub-tabs 'All/Pending/Applied/Rejected' but the implemented UI only has All/Pending/Applied (Rejected is a status, not a tab). Confirm intended behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Redesign is clean: dark sidebar + bone content area + lime accent applied consistently across all 5 protected pages. Serif display headings + mono micro-labels render correctly.
All existing data-testid values preserved (nav-*, user-menu-trigger, logout-btn, page-level testids) — no breakage to test contracts.
Auth wiring via cookie session_token works end-to-end; ProtectedRoute correctly gates and hydrates user data.
test_credentials: cookie session_token=ui-preview-token-777 (user_id ui-preview-user, alex@example.com) — seeded and active in Mongo
seed_data_creation: None (existing seed already active and verified)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All redesign pages render with 0 console errors on desktop and mobile. The only console noise comes from the mocked Ashby aggregator on /jobs (network fetch error) — expected. Applications page has 3 sub-tabs (All/Pending/Applied), no separate Rejected tab. Cookie must have secure=True, sameSite='None' when setting via Playwright.
